BusinessContext.Description: Critical migration from SWIFT MT103 (legacy format) to ISO 20022 pacs.008.001.08 (FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer). Part of the global SWIFT migration initiative where all MT messages will be replaced by MX (ISO 20022) by November 2025. MT103 is used for single customer credit transfers, while pacs.008 is its ISO 20022 equivalent with enhanced structured data, better compliance support, and richer remittance information capabilities.
BusinessContext.ApplicableDomains: Payments Hub, Treasury Operations, Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, Trade Finance, Compliance, AML Screening

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: mt103_reference = source.field_20 current_time = format_timestamp("YYYYMMDDHHmmss") message_id = mt103_reference + "_" + current_time if (length(message_id) > MAX_MSG_ID_LENGTH) then message_id = substring(message_id, 1, MAX_MSG_ID_LENGTH) endif return message_id

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing mandatory field 20"
REJECT with error "Field 20 exceeds maximum length of 16 characters"
REJECT with error "Field 20 contains invalid characters"
REJECT with error "Duplicate message ID detected"

General.ImpactIfFails: Message rejected - cannot process without unique identifier. Risk of duplicate payment if uniqueness not enforced.
General.BusinessRationale: Ensures end-to-end traceability across MT103 and pacs.008 systems. Critical for payment tracking, reconciliation, and investigations.
General.AuditRequirement: All message IDs must be logged with originating MT103 reference and conversion timestamp for minimum AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years per SOX compliance.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Unique message identification required per SWIFT Standards and ISO 20022 business rules. Duplicate prevention required per PSD2 Article 80.
General.DataPrivacy: Message ID itself is not PII. No GDPR special handling required for this field.
General.MigrationNote: MT103 field 20 is 16 chars max, pacs.008 MsgId is 35 chars max. Timestamp suffix appended to prevent collisions in high-volume environments where same reference may be reused across days.
General.CachingStrategy: Processed message IDs cached in Redis for DUPLICATE_DETECTION_WINDOW_DAYS days to enable fast duplicate detection without full database scan.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: current_time = system_current_time() iso_formatted = format_datetime(current_time, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ") return iso_formatted

Condition.ElseAction: N/A
CONVERT_TO_UTC before setting field

General.ImpactIfFails: Message rejected by receiving system due to missing mandatory header field.
General.BusinessRationale: ISO 20022 requires precise creation timestamp for message ordering, replay detection, and SLA measurement. MT103 has no equivalent field - SWIFT FIN network handles its own timestamps.
General.AuditRequirement: Conversion timestamp logged alongside original MT103 reception time to measure processing latency per SLA monitoring.
General.ComplianceRequirement: ISO 20022 XML schema validation will reject message if CreDtTm is absent or malformed. UTC timezone required for cross-border consistency.
General.DataPrivacy: Timestamp is operational metadata. No PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: New mandatory field in ISO 20022 with no MT103 equivalent. Must be generated at conversion time. Always UTC (Z suffix) for consistency across time zones and DST changes.
General.CachingStrategy: Not applicable - timestamp must always reflect actual conversion moment.

Condition.ElseAction: N/A

Variable.name: MT103_TRANSACTION_COUNT
Variable.description: MT103 always carries exactly one transaction - static constant

General.ImpactIfFails: ISO 20022 schema validation failure - NbOfTxs is mandatory in pacs.008 group header.
General.BusinessRationale: MT103 represents a single customer credit transfer by definition. pacs.008 supports batches but MT103 migration always produces count of 1. Required for schema compliance and downstream batch reconciliation.
General.AuditRequirement: No specific audit requirement for this field beyond standard message logging.
General.ComplianceRequirement: ISO 20022 pacs.008 schema requires NbOfTxs to equal the actual number of CdtTrfTxInf blocks. Always 1 for MT103 conversions.
General.DataPrivacy: Not applicable - count field contains no personal data.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 bulk (batch) to pacs.008 conversion would require dynamic count. For MT103 one-to-one conversion always hardcoded to 1.

MappingFormula.Expression: currency = extract_currency(source.field_32A, position 7-9) amount = extract_amount(source.field_32A, position 10+) amount_decimal = parse_decimal(amount) target.InstdAmt = create_xml_amount(amount_decimal, currency)
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_32a = source.field_32A value_date = substring(field_32a, 1, 6) currency_code = substring(field_32a, 7, 3) amount_string = substring(field_32a, 10) amount_normalized = replace(amount_string, ",", ".") amount_decimal = parse_decimal(amount_normalized) xml_amount = { value: amount_decimal, currency: currency_code } return xml_amount

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing mandatory field 32A"
REJECT with error "Invalid field 32A format - expected YYMMDDCCCNNNNN,NN"
REJECT with error "Invalid or unsupported currency code"
REJECT with error "Amount out of valid range (must be > 0 and <= MAX_AMOUNT)"
ROUND to MAX_DECIMAL_PLACES decimal places AND LOG warning
FLAG for AML compliance review AND PROCEED

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment cannot be executed. Wrong amount credited to beneficiary causes financial loss and potential legal liability.
General.BusinessRationale: Core financial value of the transaction. Any parsing or rounding error directly impacts the amount credited or debited. Basis for all downstream calculations including fees, FX, and GL posting.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (string parsing and decimal conversion - no external service call)
General.AuditRequirement: All amount conversions must be logged with original MT103 value (comma decimal) and converted value (dot decimal) per SOX financial controls. Amounts above LARGE_AMOUNT_THRESHOLD must generate AML alert log entry.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Amounts above LARGE_AMOUNT_THRESHOLD (10 000 EUR) must be flagged per EU 4th AML Directive Article 11. Currency must be on approved list per sanctions regulations.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction amount is not PII under GDPR. However combined with account data it becomes sensitive - access restricted to authorized payment processing roles.
General.MigrationNote: CRITICAL FORMAT DIFFERENCE: SWIFT uses comma as decimal separator (25000,00). ISO 20022 uses dot as decimal separator (25000.00). This conversion is mandatory and must never be skipped. Amount precision is always 2 decimal places for major currencies.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - amount must always be read directly from source message.

MappingFormula.Expression: lines = split_lines(source.field_50K) IF starts_with(lines[0], '/') THEN name_lines = lines[1:] ELSE name_lines = lines ENDIF debtor_name = trim(name_lines[0]) target.Dbtr_Nm = debtor_name
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_50k_content = source.field_50K lines = split_by_newline(field_50k_content) if (starts_with(lines[0], "/")) then name_address_lines = lines[1:] else name_address_lines = lines endif debtor_name = name_address_lines[0] debtor_name = trim(debtor_name) if (length(debtor_name) > 140) then debtor_name = substring(debtor_name, 1, 140) endif return debtor_name

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing mandatory field 50K - ordering customer required"
REJECT with error "Cannot extract debtor name from field 50K"
TRUNCATE to 140 characters AND LOG warning with original value
BLOCK message AND ALERT compliance team immediately
FLAG for enhanced due diligence review AND PROCEED with hold

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment rejected. Serious compliance violation if sanctioned entity not detected. Potential regulatory fine and reputational damage.
General.BusinessRationale: Identity of the payer is mandatory for AML/KYC compliance, sanctions screening against OFAC/EU/UN lists, PEP screening, transaction monitoring, and fraud detection. Required by FATF Travel Rule to accompany all wire transfers.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM - text parsing is fast but sanctions screening API call adds 50-200ms latency. Batch screening available for non-real-time flows.
General.AuditRequirement: Sanctions and PEP screening results must be logged with timestamp, list version used, and decision for AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years. Required by EU 4th AML Directive Article 40.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Mandatory real-time sanctions screening per OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated List (Regulation 2580/2001), UN Security Council Consolidated List. PEP screening per 4th and 5th EU AML Directives.
General.DataPrivacy: Debtor name is PII under GDPR Article 4. Must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Access logged for audit. Retention subject to GDPR right to erasure with exemption for AML compliance records per GDPR Article 17(3)(b).
General.MigrationNote: MT103 field 50K combines account + name + address in free text format (4 lines of 35 chars). ISO 20022 separates these into distinct structured elements (Nm, PstlAdr). Parser must intelligently identify where name ends and address begins.
General.CachingStrategy: Sanctions list cached locally and refreshed every 4 hours. Individual name screening results NOT cached to prevent false negatives from stale data.

MappingFormula.Expression: lines = split_lines(source.field_50K) IF starts_with(lines[0], '/') THEN account_line = substring(lines[0], 2) IF is_iban_format(account_line) THEN target.DbtrAcct_Id_IBAN = account_line ELSE target.DbtrAcct_Id_Othr = account_line ENDIF ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_50k_content = source.field_50K lines = split_by_newline(field_50k_content) first_line = lines[0] if (starts_with(first_line, "/")) then account_number = substring(first_line, 2) if (matches_iban_pattern(account_number) AND is_valid_iban_checksum(account_number)) then debtor_iban = account_number else debtor_account_other = account_number debtor_iban = null endif else debtor_iban = null endif return debtor_iban

Condition.ElseAction: SET_TO_NULL - account number not provided in field 50K
STORE_IN_OTHER_IDENTIFIER element instead of IBAN element
REJECT with error "Invalid IBAN checksum for debtor account"
LOG_WARNING "Unknown IBAN country code" AND PROCEED

Variable.name: SEPA_REQUIRES_IBAN
Variable.description: SEPA zone payments require IBAN for debtor account

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment may still succeed but reconciliation becomes difficult. Regulatory reporting incomplete. SEPA payments require IBAN - rejection risk for EUR payments.
General.BusinessRationale: Account identification for debit reconciliation. Essential for automated straight-through processing (STP), regulatory reporting, and SEPA compliance where IBAN is mandatory.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (regex pattern match + modulo 97 checksum calculation - fully in-memory)
General.AuditRequirement: Account numbers stored encrypted. Access to account data logged. Retention per AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years regulatory requirement.
General.ComplianceRequirement: SEPA Regulation 260/2012 mandates IBAN for EUR payments within SEPA zone. Non-SEPA payments may use proprietary account format stored in OthrId element.
General.DataPrivacy: Account number is PII and financial data under GDPR. Must be pseudonymized in logs and analytics. Full account number only accessible to authorized payment processing systems.
General.MigrationNote: MT103 field 50K optionally contains account on first line with slash prefix. ISO 20022 provides separate structured elements for IBAN and other account identifiers. Checksum validation mandatory before storing.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - account number extracted directly from message each time.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_52A != null THEN target.DbtrAgt_FinInstnId_BICFI = extract_bic(source.field_52A) ELSE target.DbtrAgt_FinInstnId_BICFI = get_sender_bic_from_header() ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: if (source.field_52A is not null) then field_52a = source.field_52A lines = split_by_newline(field_52a) if (starts_with(lines[0], "/")) then bic_code = lines[1] else bic_code = lines[0] endif if (is_valid_bic(bic_code)) then debtor_agent_bic = bic_code else throw error "Invalid BIC format in field 52A" endif else debtor_agent_bic = message_header.sender_bic endif return debtor_agent_bic

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Cannot determine debtor agent - field 52A absent and no sender BIC in header"
REJECT with error "Invalid BIC format - must be 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters"
LOG_WARNING "BIC not found in SWIFT directory" AND PROCEED - may be valid non-SWIFT institution
BLOCK message AND ALERT compliance team

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment routing failure - cannot identify institution responsible for debiting ordering customer. Correspondent banking chain broken.
General.BusinessRationale: Identifies the financial institution that will debit the ordering customer account. Essential for interbank settlement routing, correspondent banking chain, and compliance traceability.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW - BIC validation is in-memory. Directory lookup served from cache (BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hour TTL). Sanctions check adds 10-50ms.
General.AuditRequirement: BIC of debtor agent must be stored with transaction for FATF Travel Rule compliance. Required for correspondent banking audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Institution-level sanctions screening required per OFAC and EU regulations. BIC must not belong to sanctioned correspondent bank.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC codes are public identifiers - not PII under GDPR. No special data protection measures required.
General.MigrationNote: MT103 field 52A is optional. Best practice fallback is to use sender BIC from SWIFT message application header (block 1) as debtor agent when field absent.
General.CachingStrategy: SWIFT BIC directory cached in memory and refreshed every BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hours. Reduces latency from ~50ms (API call) to under 1ms (memory lookup).

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_57a = source.field_57A if (field_57a is not null) then lines = split_by_newline(field_57a) if (starts_with(lines[0], "/")) then bic_code = lines[1] else bic_code = lines[0] endif creditor_agent_bic = validate_and_clean_bic(bic_code) else creditor_agent_bic = null endif return creditor_agent_bic

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing mandatory field 57A - creditor agent required for routing"
REJECT with error "Invalid BIC format in field 57A"
REJECT with error "Beneficiary bank BIC not reachable via SWIFT network"

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment cannot be delivered to beneficiary. Funds stuck in transit. Customer complaint and potential SLA breach.
General.BusinessRationale: Identifies the financial institution that will credit the beneficiary account. Absolutely critical for payment routing and delivery. Without this, payment has no destination.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW - BIC validation and reachability check served from BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hour cache.
General.AuditRequirement: Creditor agent BIC stored for end-to-end payment traceability and correspondent banking reconciliation.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Reachability verification prevents payments to non-SWIFT institutions. Sanctions check against beneficiary bank required per OFAC and EU regulations.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT103 field 57A maps directly to CdtrAgt in pacs.008. Field is mandatory in practice even though technically optional in schema - most receiving banks reject without it.
General.CachingStrategy: BIC reachability data cached with BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hour TTL. SWIFT connectivity status refreshed from SWIFT Alliance Gateway every hour.

MappingFormula.Expression: lines = split_lines(source.field_59) IF starts_with(lines[0], '/') THEN name_lines = lines[1:] ELSE name_lines = lines ENDIF creditor_name = trim(name_lines[0]) target.Cdtr_Nm = creditor_name
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_59_content = source.field_59 lines = split_by_newline(field_59_content) if (starts_with(lines[0], "/")) then name_address_lines = lines[1:] else name_address_lines = lines endif creditor_name = name_address_lines[0] creditor_name = trim_and_normalize(creditor_name) if (length(creditor_name) > 140) then creditor_name = substring(creditor_name, 1, 140) endif return creditor_name

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing mandatory field 59 - beneficiary customer required"
BLOCK message AND ALERT compliance team immediately
FLAG for manual review - potential fraud or mule account

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment blocked. Compliance violation if sanctioned beneficiary not detected. Financial crime facilitation risk.
General.BusinessRationale: Identity of the payee is critical for sanctions screening, fraud detection (name/account mismatch), payment reconciliation, and FATF Travel Rule compliance. Must be stored with every transaction.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM - text extraction fast but sanctions API adds 50-200ms. Name matching algorithm adds 10-30ms.
General.AuditRequirement: Beneficiary name and sanctions screening result logged for AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years. Mandatory per EU 4th AML Directive and FATF Travel Rule Recommendation 16.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Real-time sanctions screening of beneficiary against OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Security Council List. Name-matching for fraud prevention per PSD2 Article 89.
General.DataPrivacy: Creditor name is PII under GDPR. Same protections as debtor name: encrypted storage, access logging, retention exemption for AML records per GDPR Article 17(3)(b).
General.MigrationNote: Same extraction logic as debtor name from field 50K but applied to field 59. Both fields share identical format: optional /account on first line followed by name and address lines.
General.CachingStrategy: Sanctions list cached, refreshed every 4 hours. Name-matching results not cached due to sensitivity.

MappingFormula.Expression: lines = split_lines(source.field_59) IF starts_with(lines[0], '/') THEN account_line = substring(lines[0], 2) IF is_iban_format(account_line) THEN target.CdtrAcct_Id_IBAN = account_line ELSE target.CdtrAcct_Id_Othr = account_line ENDIF ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_59_content = source.field_59 lines = split_by_newline(field_59_content) first_line = lines[0] if (starts_with(first_line, "/")) then account_number = substring(first_line, 2) if (matches_iban_pattern(account_number) AND is_valid_iban_checksum(account_number)) then creditor_iban = account_number else creditor_account_other = account_number creditor_iban = null endif else creditor_iban = null endif return creditor_iban

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Invalid IBAN checksum for creditor account"
REJECT with error "Inactive or closed beneficiary account"

Variable.name: SEPA_REQUIRES_CREDITOR_IBAN
Variable.description: SEPA credit transfers require creditor IBAN

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment credited to wrong account or rejected by receiving bank. Financial loss and customer dispute.
General.BusinessRationale: Destination account for funds crediting. Any error results in misposted payment, which requires manual reversal and customer remediation. Accounts payable reconciliation depends on correct account identification.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM - IBAN checksum calculated locally but account status check requires API call to receiving bank or internal account database (~100ms).
General.AuditRequirement: Creditor account number stored encrypted with transaction for 7 years. Required for payment investigation and regulatory reporting.
General.ComplianceRequirement: SEPA Regulation 260/2012: IBAN mandatory for EUR payments in SEPA zone. Account status verification required to prevent payments to closed accounts per bank operating procedures.
General.DataPrivacy: Account number is highly sensitive financial PII. Pseudonymized in logs. Full account number access restricted to payment processing and reconciliation systems only.
General.MigrationNote: Identical extraction logic to debtor account (MAPPING_06) but applied to field 59. In SEPA zone, creditor IBAN is mandatory - rejection rate for missing IBAN very high with SEPA CSMs.
General.CachingStrategy: Account validation results not cached - account status must be checked in real-time to prevent posting to recently closed accounts.

MappingFormula.Expression: lines = split_lines(source.field_70) remittance_text = join(lines, " ") remittance_normalized = normalize_whitespace(remittance_text) IF length(remittance_normalized) > REMITTANCE_MAX_LENGTH THEN target.RmtInf_Ustrd = substring(remittance_normalized, 1, REMITTANCE_MAX_LENGTH) ELSE target.RmtInf_Ustrd = remittance_normalized ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_70_content = source.field_70 if (field_70_content is not null) then lines = split_by_newline(field_70_content) remittance_text = join(lines, " ") remittance_text = replace_multiple_spaces_with_single(remittance_text) remittance_text = trim(remittance_text) if (length(remittance_text) > REMITTANCE_MAX_LENGTH) then remittance_text = substring(remittance_text, 1, REMITTANCE_MAX_LENGTH) log_warning("Remittance information truncated") endif else remittance_text = null endif return remittance_text

Condition.Action: PROCESS if present, skip if null
Condition.ElseAction: N/A - field is optional
TRUNCATE to REMITTANCE_MAX_LENGTH characters AND LOG warning with original length
FLAG for AML compliance review AND PROCEED

General.ImpactIfFails: Loss of payment purpose information. Customer reconciliation failure. Invoice matching impossible for accounts payable automation.
General.BusinessRationale: Provides context for payment purpose critical for invoice matching, accounts payable automation, and regulatory reporting. Also screened for AML suspicious keywords (weapon, narco, etc.).
General.PerformanceImpact: NEGLIGIBLE (string manipulation only - no external calls)
General.AuditRequirement: Remittance text logged with transaction for reconciliation audit trail. AML keyword flags logged separately with compliance alert.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Remittance information screened for AML suspicious patterns per bank AML policy. Some jurisdictions require structured remittance (ISO 11649 creditor reference) for regulatory reporting.
General.DataPrivacy: Remittance text may contain personal references (invoice to John Doe, etc.) making it potentially PII. Treat with same protections as name fields.
General.MigrationNote: MT103 field 70 is unstructured free text (4 lines x 35 chars = 140 chars total). ISO 20022 offers both Ustrd (unstructured, like MT103) and Strd (structured, machine-readable invoice references). MT103 migration uses Ustrd. Advanced implementations may parse and structure the content into ISO 11649 format.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching required - pure text transformation.

MappingFormula.Expression: SWITCH source.field_71A: CASE "OUR": target.ChrgBr = "DEBT" CASE "BEN": target.ChrgBr = "CRED" CASE "SHA": target.ChrgBr = "SHAR" DEFAULT: target.ChrgBr = DEFAULT_CHARGE_BEARER END_SWITCH
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: mt103_code = source.field_71A charge_code_map = { "OUR": "DEBT", "BEN": "CRED", "SHA": "SHAR" } if (charge_code_map.contains(mt103_code)) then iso20022_code = charge_code_map[mt103_code] else iso20022_code = DEFAULT_CHARGE_BEARER log_warning("Unknown charge code " + mt103_code + ", defaulting to " + DEFAULT_CHARGE_BEARER) endif if (transaction_currency == SEPA_CURRENCY AND iso20022_code != "SHAR") then log_warning("EUR SEPA payment overridden to SHAR per EU Regulation 924/2009") iso20022_code = "SHAR" endif return iso20022_code

Condition.ElseAction: SET_TO_DEFAULT (DEFAULT_CHARGE_BEARER = SHAR) AND LOG warning
LOG_WARNING and USE_DEFAULT (DEFAULT_CHARGE_BEARER)
OVERRIDE to SHAR - EU Regulation 924/2009 mandates SHA for EUR SEPA payments

General.ImpactIfFails: Incorrect charge allocation causes financial dispute between sender and receiver banks. Revenue impact on fee collection.
General.BusinessRationale: Determines who pays bank processing charges. Affects net amount received by beneficiary and bank fee revenue. EU Regulation 924/2009 mandates SHA for EUR payments within SEPA - automatic override applied.
General.PerformanceImpact: NEGLIGIBLE (simple map lookup and one conditional check)
General.AuditRequirement: Charge bearer code logged with transaction. Any regulatory override logged with original value and override reason.
General.ComplianceRequirement: EU Regulation 924/2009 Article 9 prohibits BEN charge bearer for EUR payments in SEPA zone. Override to SHA must be applied automatically. Some countries (e.g. Australia) have additional charge bearer restrictions for consumer protection.
General.DataPrivacy: Charge bearer code is operational data. No PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: Clean 1:1 code translation table. MT103 OUR maps to ISO 20022 DEBT (both mean sender pays all). BEN maps to CRED (receiver pays all). SHA maps to SHAR (shared). ISO 20022 adds SLEV (follow service level agreement) which has no MT103 equivalent.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - static lookup table loaded at startup.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_23B == "SPAY" THEN target.Purp_Cd = "SALA" ELSE IF source.field_23B == "CRED" THEN IF contains(source.field_70, "INVOICE") THEN target.Purp_Cd = "SUPP" ELSE IF contains(source.field_70, "SALARY") THEN target.Purp_Cd = "SALA" ELSE target.Purp_Cd = "GDDS" ENDIF ELSE IF source.field_23B == "CRTS" THEN target.Purp_Cd = "TRAD" ELSE target.Purp_Cd = "OTHR" ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: bank_op_code = source.field_23B remittance = to_lowercase(source.field_70) if (bank_op_code == "SPAY") then purpose_code = "SALA" else if (bank_op_code == "CRED") then if (contains(remittance, "invoice") OR contains(remittance, "inv")) then purpose_code = "SUPP" else if (contains(remittance, "salary") OR contains(remittance, "payroll")) then purpose_code = "SALA" else if (contains(remittance, "loan") OR contains(remittance, "credit")) then purpose_code = "LOAN" else if (contains(remittance, "rent")) then purpose_code = "RENT" else purpose_code = "GDDS" endif else if (bank_op_code == "CRTS") then purpose_code = "TRAD" else purpose_code = "OTHR" endif return purpose_code

Condition.ElseAction: USE_DEFAULT ("OTHR") AND LOG for manual review
USE_GENERIC_CODE ("OTHR") AND LOG for potential manual classification

Condition.Action: ENSURE_PURPOSE_SET with derived or default value
Condition.ElseAction: OPTIONAL - field may be left empty for non-requiring destinations

Variable.name: PURPOSE_CODE_REQUIRED_COUNTRIES
Variable.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes where purpose code is mandatory for cross-border payments

Variable.name: KEYWORD_MAP_VERSION
Variable.description: Version of the keyword-to-purpose-code mapping table in use

General.ImpactIfFails: Payments to countries requiring purpose code (China, India, Russia, Brazil) may be rejected by receiving bank. Statistical reporting to central bank incomplete.
General.BusinessRationale: Purpose codes enable central bank statistical reporting, regulatory compliance for capital controls, automated routing rules in treasury systems, and tax reporting. Mandatory in several jurisdictions.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (keyword search in remittance field - in-memory string operations only)
General.AuditRequirement: Derived purpose code logged with confidence score and derivation method for quality monitoring. Allows retroactive correction if keyword model updated.
General.ComplianceRequirement: China PBOC requires purpose code for all inbound cross-border payments. India RBI requires for certain transaction types. Brazil Bacen requires for regulatory reporting. EU/US optional but strongly recommended for STP.
General.DataPrivacy: Purpose code itself is not PII. Derived from remittance which may contain PII references - derivation process does not store remittance content separately.
General.MigrationNote: MAJOR CHALLENGE: Purpose code does not exist in MT103. Must be derived entirely from field 23B (4 values) and keyword analysis of field 70 (free text). Derivation accuracy typically 60-80%. Banks with higher accuracy requirements use ML model trained on historical transaction data. Manual override workflow recommended for high-value transactions to PURPOSE_CODE_REQUIRED_COUNTRIES.
General.CachingStrategy: Keyword lookup table (KEYWORD_MAP_VERSION) loaded at startup and cached in memory. No per-transaction caching needed.
